method: Continue retained and previously reviewed Homann major-jurisdiction envelopes across the economic Franconia/Bavaria boundary. No new projection fit, arbitrary dilation or nearest-city partition. Only four still-Bavarian parents are eligible.
warning: Existing simplified jurisdiction envelopes, not a cadastral reconstruction. The source edition is undated; retained Le Rouge and institutional evidence corroborate the major estates, not every village boundary.

The retained Regensburg check differs by 5.121 pixels and is a native game city anchor, not independent surveyed ground truth. This lot accepts explicitly approximate game-scale boundaries; it does not certify sub-3-pixel geographic precision.

Four Bavaria-region parents only. All prior Franconian allocations, including Wurzburg and Bayreuth, are preserved byte-for-byte geometrically. A one-cell Nuremberg edge intersection in x82F4B9 is deliberately not transferred.

Southern Eichstatt estates beyond the already reviewed northern-mainland polygon remain pending. Rothenburg, Hohenlohe, smaller enclaves and uncertain franges are not assigned to neighbours by proximity.

Erfurt-Eichsfeld and the rejected 7.20-pixel translation are wholly excluded. Populations are redistributed by existing subdivision pixel weights, not asserted as historical district censuses; no people are added.
